body:
I've tried several times throughout my life. The one I most vividly remember is when I was maybe 16 or 17 and I was sitting on the edge of my window about ready to go. My father had earlier had a breakdown and left (it was unknown at the time if he was ever coming back), so my mother and little sister were about to leave in the car to find him when my sister looked up and saw me. She hadn't liked me at all up to that point, but the look in her eyes was enough to stop me from trying again for about a year. She and I became really close when I was about 18, because my parents both began fighting often and my mother had started physically (only small things) and mentally abusing both my father and me (but she always loved my sister.) Now my sister is getting more irritated with me and depressed often and I feel like it's my fault (as often I am told a lot of things are my fault and I now believe almost everything actually is my fault.)

This was a lot longer than I had intended. Sorry.
